kpis.name: Registry entries at latest version

kpis.name: Registry findable share
kpis.why: Search is name-only; a server nobody can find by the words they type does not exist.

kpis.name: Distribution surfaces live
kpis.why: Each free registry or catalog is a compounding source of installs.

kpis.name: Pages indexed on the storefront sitemap
kpis.why: Long-tail search queries are the only paid-free channel with measured intent.

kpis.name: Bundle downloads (all releases)
kpis.why: The first hard signal that a listing turned into an install attempt.

kpis.name: npm weekly downloads
kpis.why: npx is the default install path in every client guide; blocked on npm login.

kpis.name: Hosted endpoints coverage
kpis.why: Hosted use is the only kind directories and registries count.

kpis.name: Anonymous hosted tokens minted
kpis.why: Someone reached a hosted endpoint without a key: a zero-friction first call.

kpis.name: Hosted tenants with stored data
kpis.why: A tenant document exists only after a mutating call succeeded.

kpis.name: Hosted downloads served
kpis.why: A produced document is a completed job, not just a call.

kpis.name: First-prompt tool reach (latest round)
kpis.unit: % of calls on the right tool
kpis.how: data/user_value_r24.json tool_selection (falls back to round 8: 50 of 51)
kpis.why: Round 6 showed correct servers losing to built-in tools; descriptions are the lever.

kpis.name: User-value score, latest round
kpis.why: Scenario scoring through a real MCP client is the only measure of value that includes the model.

kpis.name: Seam defects fixed of found
kpis.how: defect ledger in the user-value tab
kpis.why: Every lost point since round 3 was a handoff between servers.

kpis.name: Servers that reached 100% in a round
kpis.why: Shows which servers are done and which still lose points on natural prompts.

kpis.name: Live validation checks passing
kpis.why: Stdio, hosted and billing exercised end to end on every change.

kpis.name: Unit tests passing
kpis.why: Regression floor; contract suites enforce stdout hygiene, quarantine, caps, licensing.

kpis.name: Hosted tools/list latency p50
kpis.why: Above about a second, clients start their first prompt before the server answers (round 4 D-R5).

kpis.name: Silent-partial-result defects open
kpis.how: audits: truncated history, capped loops, partial files all fixed
kpis.why: A plausible wrong answer costs more than an error.

kpis.name: Checkout sessions from humans (last 100)
kpis.how: stripe checkout sessions list --live, metadata.probe absent
kpis.why: Validation probes create sessions too; only untagged ones are demand.

kpis.name: Paid sessions
kpis.why: The number that matters.

kpis.name: License keys minted
kpis.how: wrangler kv key list --remote on LICENSES
kpis.why: One key per paid session; zero means no purchase reached /success.

kpis.name: Upgrade link clicks (humans, 7d)
kpis.how: GET https://mcp.zovo.one/stats/clicks, sum of by_src[*].last7d; the billing worker excludes probe-tagged and scripted user agents before counting
kpis.why: The click is the step between a cap message and a checkout session; without it a stalled funnel and a message nobody reads look the same.

kpis.name: Click to checkout-session ratio
kpis.how: 100 * checkout sessions from humans (last 100, Stripe) / upgrade link clicks (7d, /stats/clicks) - the two windows differ (last 100 ever vs last 7 days), so this is an approximation, not the true window-matched ratio
kpis.why: Separates whether people are seeing the link (clicks) from whether the checkout page itself converts (ratio); a link with clicks and no sessions points at the redirect or the Stripe page, not the message.

kpis.name: Pro tenants on hosted endpoints
kpis.how: Stripe-bound tenants (REMOTE_DATA bind: prefix, 0) plus distinct lic: tenant ids whose key the billing worker minted (LICENSES session:*, 0 keys). EXCLUDED: the 1423 raw lic: documents are per (key, server) pairs, not tenants (185 distinct ids), and 185 of those ids are validation probes signed locally by scripts/sign-license.mjs, never bought.
kpis.why: Real Pro usage on hosted. The old count read every lic: document, so one validation run over 16 servers looked like 16 paying tenants.

stripe.note: sessions created before 2026-09-03 08:55 UTC predate probe tagging and are excluded
